description: JOLT is a game-based daily-claim token on BNB Smart Chain. Players solve the CORE RUSH route puzzle to receive a signed voucher and claim JOLT on-chain. Its 3-day claim season concluded with 283 claims, and the JOLT/WBNB PancakeSwap V2 pool is now live with burned LP and a 2% trading tax.
